items.title: Dana McNabb named General Mills CEO, succeeding Jeff Harmening
items.summary: General Mills has named Dana McNabb as its new Chief Executive Officer, effective January 1, 2027, making her the first woman to lead the company in its 160-year history. McNabb, who has been with General Mills for 27 years and previously served as COO, will succeed Jeff Harmening, who will transition to executive chair. Her primary focus will be returning the company to profitable growth amidst a challenging period for packaged food companies.

items.title: Conagra Brands, Inc (CAG) Q1 2027 Earnings Call Transcript
items.summary: Conagra Brands discussed its Q1 FY27 earnings, reaffirming its full-year outlook despite a beat in Q1 driven by SG&A timing, Ardent Mills benefit, lower inflation, and a tariff refund. The company outlined its strategy for managing higher transportation inflation, deleveraging to a 3x target, and optimizing its product portfolio through SKU simplification and increased A&P spending. Conagra emphasized a prudent approach to elasticity assumptions and a focus on core platforms and brand building.

items.title: 8x8, Commerce, Sprout Social, Tenable, and HubSpot Shares Skyrocket, What You Need To Know
items.summary: Shares of 8x8, Commerce, Sprout Social, Tenable, and HubSpot all saw significant jumps following a report from the Bureau of Economic Analysis showing a 0.9% increase in personal consumption expenditures for August. This data, coupled with a modest 0.2% uptick in personal income and subdued inflation, signaled resilient consumer demand and bolstered market confidence. Tenable, in particular, saw a 6% increase and is up 63.4% year-to-date, despite historical underperformance for long-term investors.

items.title: Phillips 66 Stock And 2 Energy Shares Facing The Next Oil Supply Test
items.summary: This article examines three energy stocks—Phillips 66 (PSX), Viva Energy Group (ASX:VEA), and CVR Energy (CVI)—that are particularly exposed to global oil market fluctuations and potential supply shocks. It highlights their unique business models, including refining, midstream, and integrated operations, and discusses the key swing factors and risks associated with each company in the context of evolving energy security and policy changes. The analysis emphasizes how these companies' earnings are tied to real-world fuel demand, refining margins, and the broader energy landscape.

items.title: Toyota global sales, production in August fall for 2nd straight month
items.summary: Toyota Motor Corp's global sales and production both declined for the second consecutive month in August, with sales falling 6.4% and production dropping 5.9%. The decline was primarily attributed to weak demand in China and fewer operating days in some countries, alongside the impact of rising gasoline prices due to the Middle East conflict and natural disasters in Japan. While sales in the U.S. and Middle East also decreased significantly, Japan saw a 9.1% increase in sales, and Suzuki Motor Corp. reported a record high in sales driven by strong demand in India.

items.title: Graphic Packaging stock price target lowered to $10 by RBC Capital
items.summary: RBC Capital has lowered its price target for Graphic Packaging Holding Company (NYSE:GPK) to $10.00 from $11.00, citing expected volume declines in Q3 and higher oil prices, while maintaining a Sector Perform rating. Despite the lowered target, InvestingPro analysis suggests the stock is currently undervalued. Separately, Graphic Packaging reported strong Q2 2026 earnings, leading to an upgraded stock rating by JPMorgan, though with an adjusted price target.

items.title: Should Investors Buy AZO Stock as Growth Meets Margin Concerns?
items.summary: AutoZone (AZO) is expanding its commercial business, store network, and supply chain, leading to strong growth but also margin pressure. While the company demonstrates solid growth drivers like increased commercial sales and record store openings, it faces risks from declining DIY segment sales, margin compression due to sales mix shifts and LIFO charges, and a leveraged balance sheet with $9.1 billion in debt. Although its valuation appears reasonable, investors are advised to hold existing stock and await a better entry point due to near-term risks.

items.title: Boeing Re-Rating in the Spotlight After $2.38B F-15EX, Navy Fighter Wins
items.summary: Boeing (NYSE: BA) recently secured two significant defense contracts: a $2.38 billion Air Force deal for 22 F-15EX fighters and a Navy selection for its next-generation F/A-XX jet. These wins are prompting investors to re-evaluate Boeing's stock, which despite its commercial aircraft recovery, still trades at a high valuation. The article discusses how these defense contracts could impact Boeing's future revenue, cash flow, and overall market perception, especially considering its current financial metrics like debt-to-equity ratio and negative free cash flow.

items.title: JINGDONG Property to Establish Advanced Logistics Facility in KEZAD
items.summary: JINGDONG Property, the infrastructure arm of JD.com, has signed an agreement with KEZAD Group to develop a 150,000 square meter advanced logistics facility in KEZAD Area A – Al Ma’mourah, expected to be delivered in 2028. This project aims to enhance supply chain efficiency, support local and international enterprises, and will create approximately 1,000 direct jobs. The facility will leverage JINGDONG Property’s expertise in intelligent operations and green building to strengthen Abu Dhabi’s position as a leading logistics and trade hub.
